summary: Clean on the MEM dimension. The packed-cell UTF-32/UTF-8 converters correctly use the align-1 load_unaligned/store_unaligned primitives for the potentially-misaligned packed-dtype src/dst pointers (never the aligned load_at/store_at), and all destination/continuation-byte writes and reads are bounds-checked against the documented buffer contracts, with no overflow on empty/edge inputs. The constants module is pure integer literals (no pointers/refcounts) and the salient sentinel values cross-check against the SQLite C API. No refcount, alignment, or buffer-overflow defects found.
